response.sql: WITH site_avg AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat HAVING AVG(m.facetfaces) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(m.facetfaces) AS overall_avg FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites s ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), status_avg AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS st_avg FROM site_avg WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat) SELECT AVG(sa.avg_faces) AS avg_face_count, AVG(sa.avg_faces - o.overall_avg) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(sa.avg_faces - st.st_avg) AS avg_above_status FROM site_avg sa JOIN status_avg st ON st.entrystat = sa.entrystat CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE sa.avg_faces > st.st_avg AND o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The overall average number of mesh faces is the row-level average of facetfaces over all scanmesh records that match a site (NULLs ignored), including sites with no entrystat.
Sites whose facetfaces are all NULL have no site average and are excluded from the status averages and from the comparison.
If the overall average is NULL, no sites count and the query returns NULLs (the aggregates over zero rows).

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the simple average of the per-site averages (every matched site weighted equally, including sites without an access status) instead of the row-level average.
